name: Mini Moving Shapes
summary: 带离散动作控制和符号状态描述的合成多模态下一状态预测数据集，支持多步想象回放。
summaryEn: A synthetic multimodal next-state prediction dataset with discrete action controls and symbolic state descriptions for multi-step imagination rollouts.
scale: Bundled sequence dataset with moving squares and circles
scaleZh: 内置移动方块和圆形序列数据集
access: Dataset bundled in the official repository and regenerable by script
accessZh: 数据集随官方仓库提供，并可通过脚本重新生成
verdict: 最小化但完整的动作条件下一状态预测基准
verdictEn: A minimal but complete action-conditioned next-state prediction benchmark
wmNote: 每个序列包含图像、文本状态和离散动作，并评估五步滚动误差。
wmNoteEn: Each sequence includes image, text state, and discrete actions with five-step rollout error evaluation.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - andrew-jeremy/Spectral-World-Models: Compact PyTorch implementation of Spectral World Models: fuses Haar-wavelet image and DCT text encoders into a shared spectral latent with low-rank action-conditioned transitions. Includes Mini Moving Shapes dataset, model variants/ablations, training/evaluation, and a quick CPU benchmark. · GitHub
evidence.statement: Bundled data.py generates moving shapes with discrete controls and next-image/text targets for multi-step rollout evaluation.
